Definition: A control that shows a group of text items, one per line, so a person can pick one.
One entry in a list. In Quorum, each entry is a ListItem object.
Where an item is in the list. The top item is at position 0, the next at position 1, and so on.
The item a person is on right now. Moving with the arrow keys changes the selection.
To choose an item, for example by double-clicking it or pressing the Space key on it.
A class with a Run action. Quorum runs it when something happens, like an item being activated.
Telling Quorum to treat an object as a more specific type, for example treating an Item as a ListItem.
